_comment: One block per client. Paste the relevant block into the site as window.CTC_CONFIG (or generate per-client). Secrets like the Meta CAPI token NEVER go here — they live in apps-script/Code.gs (server-side).

client-acme._directModeOnly: Fields below are used ONLY if you set fireDirect:true (i.e. you are NOT using GTM). With GTM, leave fireDirect:false and configure tags in GTM instead.
